name: Merge queue help
description: Help mode entries of the merge queue (help@1).
author: Brett

entries.title: Merge queue
entries.text: Every build waiting to land, live from the builds store. It is read-only: the lander merges each build's steps into one PR, pulls main, runs CI once and merges it by itself.

entries.title: Waiting to land
entries.text: One row a build: its status and how long it has been in it, its PRs, and what happens next. Failed shows the attempt; the lander retries by itself. Open a row to see its steps and the PR each one was added to.

entries.title: Merge queue settings
entries.text: Install and uninstall. The merge queue keeps no data and has no settings of its own; the lander's settings (the one-PR size cap) are under Gate → Server auto-lander.

steps.say: Everything waiting to land, with its live status. Nothing to press: it all lands by itself.
